narr: A thunderstorm produced heavy rain and flash flooding in and around Clarkdale.
ev: Two inches of rain (radar estimate) from a thunderstorm caused flash flooding in Clarkdale. Water flowed over sections of Wildhorse Lane and Old Jerome Highway. Police reported mud and rocks on the roadways with both streets barricaded.
lsr: FLASH FLOODING OCCURRED RESULTING IN WATER FLOWING OVER SECTIONS OF WILDHORSE LANE AND OLD JEROME HIGHWAY IN CLARKDALE. POLICE REPORTED ROCKS AND MUD ON THE ROADWAYS WITH PORTIONS OF BOTH STREETS BAR
